answer_1.quote: We further evaluate ... on a broad range of tasks including sentence classification, machine translation, language modeling and text generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated translations, generated abstracts, classification predictions, latent representations

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of abstracts with 3 major metrics: BLEU (uni-gram to 4-gram BLEU), METEOR, ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation. ... we give 50 test datapoints to experts (5 computer science students) and ask them to provide per-criterion judgments for the generated abstracts.
answer_4.guideline: per-criterion judgments for the generated abstracts
